title: Rev. Code Wash. § 4.16.080 — Actions limited to three years
content:
RCW 4.16.080

Actions limited to three years. The following actions shall be commenced within three years:

(1) An action for waste or trespass upon real property;

(2) An action for taking, detaining, or injuring personal property, including an action for the specific recovery thereof, or for any other injury to the person or rights of another not hereinafter enumerated.

title: Rev. Code Wash. § 62A.2-725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
RCW 62A.2-725

(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within four years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than one year but may not extend it.

title: Hartley v. State, 103 Wn.2d 651 (1985)
content:
Hartley v. State, 103 Wn.2d 651 (1985).

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Supreme Court of Washington held that the State and its subdivisions are liable for injuries caused by dangerous conditions on public roads when the entity had notice of the condition and failed to remedy it within a reasonable time.

opinionParts.content: The State is liable for injuries from dangerous road conditions when it had notice and failed to remedy the condition within a reasonable time.
